protocolBuilder.cardDisplay.fieldHint: Choose any additional roster attributes that will help participants recognize an alter.
protocolBuilder.censusPrompts.ordinalBin: Interviewer will render each option in your ordinal attribute using a color gradient.
protocolBuilder.codebookEntity.colorHint: {entity, select, node {Choose a color reference for this node type.} edge {Choose a color reference for this edge type.} other {Choose a color reference for this ego definition.}}
protocolBuilder.geospatial.appearanceDes: Customize the colors, style, and features of the map.
protocolBuilder.geospatial.colorHint: Choose the color used to outline selectable GeoJSON areas and highlight the area a participant selects. Use a color that remains easy to distinguish from the chosen Mapbox style.
protocolBuilder.geospatial.initialMapVie: Configure the initial map view to adjust where it will be centered and zoomed to.
protocolBuilder.geospatial.layerHint: Choose a GeoJSON resource containing the geographic areas participants can select. Each feature should include a property that identifies the area, such as a census tract, ZIP code, or neighborhood; after selecting the resource, choose which property value to record below. Avoid very large files or features outside the study area, as they can slow map loading.
protocolBuilder.geospatial.propertyHint: The value of this property is what gets stored when a participant selects an area, so choose one that is filled in and unique for every feature — a census tract, a postcode, or a neighborhood name.
protocolBuilder.geospatial.propertyNoPro: The features in this layer carry no properties, so there is nothing to record a selection as. Choose a layer whose features are labeled.
protocolBuilder.geospatial.searchHint: Allow participants to search the map for addresses, neighborhoods, and points of interest.
protocolBuilder.geospatial.styleHint: Choose the Mapbox basemap displayed beneath the selectable GeoJSON areas. Consider the contrast between the basemap, the configured outline color, and any place labels participants need to read.
protocolBuilder.geospatial.viewDescripti: Set where the map is centered and how far it is zoomed when the stage opens.
protocolBuilder.narrativePedigree.diseas: Select a color for this disease.
Choose a color for this disease.
Shown to the participant in the pedigree's key, so it should be a name they recognize.
Define the diseases to visualize on the pedigree. Each disease maps to a boolean node attribute from the source Family Pedigree stage.
protocolBuilder.narrativePedigree.source: Select the Family Pedigree stage whose network data this Narrative Pedigree will visualize. Only Family Pedigree stages are listed here.
The stage this one reads is no longer a Family Pedigree, so there is no family for it to visualize. Choose a Family Pedigree stage instead.
protocolBuilder.networkCanvas.background: When enabled, the inner circles will be proportionally larger than the outer circles, which can help reduce overlap of nodes in the center of the canvas.
protocolBuilder.networkCanvas.composerEd: The kind of connection the participant draws. Its name and color come from the codebook.
protocolBuilder.networkCanvas.composerNo: Configure attribute mappings, layout behavior, group hulls, and editable node attributes.
protocolBuilder.networkCanvas.presetConn: Select the edge types shown in this visualization preset.
protocolBuilder.networkCanvas.presetsDes: Create visualizations that researchers can switch between during the interview.
protocolBuilder.networkCanvas.presetsFie: Add one or more "presets" below, to create different visualizations that you can switch between within the interview.
protocolBuilder.pedigree.dependentStages: These stages visualize this pedigree's network and map their own attributes onto its node type: {stageNames}. Changing the node type here will leave them pointing at attributes the new type does not have.
